title: Vision: a one-stop shop for SWG modders
summary: Strategic vision positioning Utinni as the single integrated modding tool for Star Wars Galaxies, replacing ~30 disparate legacy editors via a plugin-based architecture.
scope: plugin pipeline (TRE Browser, IFF Editor, Datatable Editor, Conversation Editor, Quest Editor, Buildout Editor, Mod Manager, etc.)
fork strategy (sovereign MIT fork of ptklatt/Utinni)
notes: Strategic vision/positioning document. Prose-heavy, no user stories or acceptance criteria (not PRD), no API/schema contracts (not SPEC), no single decision with Context/Decision/Consequences (not ADR). Contains a long-range plugin wishlist and anti-goals but explicitly self-describes as 'strategic statement, not a roadmap'. Classified as DOC (context only) per taxonomy; synthesizer should treat the goal/anti-goal/wave-ordering content as steering context for any downstream PRDs.
